ja: 湖のそばのあのキャビン、借りようよ。
en: Let's rent that cabin by the lake.
alternatives: Want to rent that cabin by the lake?
How about renting that cabin by the lake?
point: 「湖のそばの」は名詞の後ろに by the lake を置く

ja: 壊れたギターのネック、プロに直してもらったんだ。
en: I had a pro fix my guitar's broken neck.
alternatives: I got a pro to fix my guitar's broken neck.
I got my guitar's broken neck fixed by a pro.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形で「〜してもらう」

ja: 野外フェス、雨で中止になったんだって。
en: Apparently, the festival was rained out.
alternatives: I heard the festival was rained out.
Apparently the festival was canceled due to rain.
point: rain out は「雨で流れる」。受け身で言う

ja: 私には静かに充電できる週末が必要だ。
en: I need a quiet weekend to recharge.
alternatives: I need a quiet weekend to unwind.
I need a peaceful weekend to recharge.
point: 「〜するための」は名詞のあとに to+原形

ja: 父は釣り大会の列に並んだに違いない。
en: Dad must have lined up for the fishing contest.
alternatives: Dad must have queued up for the fishing contest.
I bet Dad lined up for the fishing contest.
point: 過去の強い推量は must have + 過去分詞で表す

ja: あのカフェに弟さんのゲームあるか知ってる？
en: Any idea if that café has your brother's game?
alternatives: Know if that café has your brother's game?
Do you know if they have your brother's game?
point: 「〜かどうか」は if で、後ろは平叙文の語順

ja: ケンは今週末に小説を書くって言ってたけど、どうだか。
en: Ken said he'd write a novel this weekend. Yeah, right.
alternatives: Ken said he'd write a novel this weekend. I doubt it.
Ken claimed he'd write a novel this weekend. Yeah, sure.
point: 「言ってた」に合わせて内容の will を would にずらす

ja: 失礼ですが、休日はどう過ごされているんですか？
en: Might I ask how you spend your days off?
alternatives: May I ask how you usually spend your days off?
Do you mind if I ask how you spend weekends?
point: how 以下は疑問文の語順にせず how you spend

ja: 時間ができたら、この本を読むよ。
en: I'll read this book when I'm free.
alternatives: I'll read this book when I have time.
When I have time, I'll read this book.
Once I'm free, I'll read this book.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形（will を使わない）

ja: 陶芸展は混むので、早めに行くといいですよ。
en: You might want to go early; it gets packed.
alternatives: It's worth going early; the show gets packed.
Better to go early; the show gets packed.
point: やわらかい助言は You might want to。混む=get packed

ja: 晴れたら日曜はサイクリングに行くよ。
en: If it's sunny, I'll go cycling Sunday.
alternatives: I'll go cycling Sunday if it's sunny.
If the weather's nice Sunday, I'm going cycling.
point: 未来のことでも if 節の中は現在形（will は使わない）

ja: たとえ雨でも土曜はみんなで山に登るよ。
en: Even if it rains, we're hiking this Saturday.
alternatives: Rain or shine, we're hiking this Saturday.
Even if it rains, we'll hike this Saturday.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if。予定は進行形で言える

ja: 癒されるのはヨガじゃなく、川沿いの散歩です。
en: It's riverside walks, not yoga, that help me unwind.
alternatives: What helps me unwind isn't yoga but river walks.
Riverside walks, not yoga, are what help me unwind.
point: It's B, not A, that で強調。that の後の動詞は B に合わせる

ja: 週末は、子どもたちに好きなだけゲームをさせてるんだ。
en: I let my kids game all they want on weekends.
alternatives: On weekends, I let my kids play video games all they want.
Weekends, I let my kids play games as much as they like.
point: let + 人 + 動詞の原形。「〜させる」は to を付けない

ja: あの棚のプラモデル、全部自分で作ったよ。
en: I built every model on that shelf myself.
alternatives: I made every model on that shelf myself.
Every model on that shelf, I built myself.
point: 「棚の」は on that shelf を名詞の後ろに置く

ja: 休日は、朝寝坊が一番の楽しみだよ。
en: On days off, I love sleeping in most.
alternatives: I like sleeping in best on days off.
On days off, I enjoy sleeping in most.
point: 「休日は」は On days off。love の後は -ing 形

ja: 買ったばかりの自転車に乗ってきたよ。
en: I rode the bike I just bought.
alternatives: I rode the bike that I just bought.
I went out on my new bike.
point: bike の後ろに I just bought を直接続ける

ja: 姉は毎週日曜、ヨガをしています。
en: My sister does yoga every Sunday.
alternatives: My sister practices yoga every Sunday.
Every Sunday, my sister does yoga.
point: 習慣は現在形、主語が三人称単数なので does

ja: 電話をくれた時、庭仕事をしてたよ。
en: I was gardening when you called.
alternatives: When you called, I was gardening.
I was gardening when you phoned.
point: 途中だった動作は過去進行形、割り込んだ出来事は過去形

ja: 父はピアノが弾けません。
en: My father can't play the piano.
alternatives: My dad can't play the piano.
My dad can't play piano.
point: can't の後ろは原形の play。楽器には the を付ける

ja: この近くにテニスコートはある？
en: Is there a tennis court nearby?
alternatives: Is there a tennis court near here?
Are there any tennis courts nearby?
point: 疑問文は Is there で始める。There is の語順のままにしない

ja: ここ、漫画がたくさんあるよ。
en: There are lots of manga here.
alternatives: This place has lots of manga.
There's a lot of manga here.
point: 「たくさんある」は There are lots of で言う

ja: 私はインドア派で、彼はいつも山に出かけてるの。
en: I'm a homebody, whereas he's always out hiking.
alternatives: I'm an indoor person, while he's always out hiking.
I stay in, whereas he's always out in the mountains.
point: 対比は whereas / while。インドア派=homebody

ja: 今までで一番楽しかった趣味は何？
en: What's the most fun hobby you've had?
alternatives: What hobby has been the most fun?
Which hobby did you enjoy the most?
point: 最上級 + you've had で「今までで」を表す

ja: 夫は日曜、ラジオを聞きながら庭いじりしてます。
en: My husband gardens on Sundays, listening to the radio.
alternatives: My husband gardens on Sundays while the radio plays.
On Sundays, my husband gardens with the radio on.
point: 「〜しながら」は文の後ろに -ing 形をつなげて表せる

ja: 週末、こんなにぐうたらじゃなければいいのに。
en: I wish I weren't such a couch potato on weekends.
alternatives: I wish I didn't laze around so much on weekends.
If only I weren't such a couch potato on weekends.
point: 今の願望は wish + 過去形。be は weren't が定番

ja: ランニングを始めてなければ、今ごろ休日は退屈だ。
en: If I'd never started running, days off would drag now.
alternatives: If I'd never taken up running, days off would drag.
Without running, my days off would be boring now.
point: 過去の仮定と今の結果は If+had 過去分詞、would+原形

ja: 君が薦めてくれた小説、週末で一気に読んだよ。
en: I binge-read that novel you recommended over the weekend.
alternatives: I devoured the novel you recommended in one weekend.
I read that novel you recommended straight through this weekend.
point: novel のあとの関係代名詞 that/which は省略できる

ja: 君も昨日の釣り、来ればよかったのに。
en: You should have come fishing yesterday.
alternatives: You should have come fishing with us yesterday.
I wish you'd come fishing yesterday.
point: 「〜すればよかったのに」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: ギターって、いつから習ってるの？
en: How long have you been learning the guitar?
alternatives: How long have you been taking guitar lessons?
When did you start learning the guitar?
point: 今も続いている期間は How long have you been 〜ing

ja: 母は最近、水彩画にすっかりはまっているんです。
en: My mom has really gotten into watercolor painting lately.
alternatives: My mother's totally hooked on watercolors these days.
My mom's really into watercolors lately.
point: 「はまる」は get into。今の状態は現在完了で言う

ja: 週末は何してるの？
en: What do you do on weekends?
alternatives: What do you usually do on weekends?
How do you spend your weekends?
point: 習慣を聞くので現在形。「週末に」は on weekends

ja: 日曜、一緒にトランプしよう。
en: Let's play cards on Sunday.
alternatives: Why don't we play cards Sunday?
Let's play a card game Sunday.
point: Let's の後ろは動詞の原形。「日曜に」は on Sunday

ja: 宝くじが当たったら、毎週末ふらっと旅に出るのにな。
en: If I won the lottery, I'd jet off every weekend.
alternatives: If I hit the jackpot, I'd be off traveling every weekend.
I'd be off somewhere every weekend if I won the lottery.
point: 現在の空想は if + 過去形、主節は would + 原形

ja: 姉のボルダリングジム、初心者クラス始めたらしいよ。
en: Apparently my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
alternatives: I hear my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
Looks like my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
point: 「らしい」は apparently や I hear で伝聞のニュアンスを出す

ja: 日曜は一日中、映画を観てたよ。
en: I watched movies all day Sunday.
alternatives: I spent all day Sunday watching movies.
I watched movies all day on Sunday.
point: 「一日中」は all day。the や a をつけない
